notes: CRITICAL VALIDATION VECTOR. Originally published in Núñez de Prado y Clavell 1992 (doctoral thesis, Universidad Complutense de Madrid); cited and reproduced by Soler 2018, pp. 138-139, with full plaintext. Uses series-A machines (A.1232-35, same batch as the Sarmiento manual's K-204). 192 cipher letters with ~190 known-plaintext letters — far superior to the manual's 34-letter example. Three embedded plaintext fragments split the ciphertext into four blocks; the Enigma rotor state is CONTINUOUS across the embedded fragments (the rotors do not reset between blocks). If neither wiring D nor F deciphers this message correctly, it CONFIRMS a third wiring (provisionally 'C') for the A.1232-35 / K.203-208 batch. Soler identifies this as 'clave Mecánica' traffic. Rotor order and Ringstellung unknown — must be brute-forced (6 × 26⁴ = 2,741,888 per wiring).
found_by: Publicat: Núñez de Prado y Clavell (1992), tesi doctoral UCM; reproduït a Soler Fuensanta (2018), pp. 138-139.

status.assessment: NO atacat encara amb el motor corregit (ETW + notch al nucli). És el millor vector disponible per al buttoning-up: 192 lletres de criptograma amb ~190 de text clar conegut i estat de rotor CONTINU a través dels tres fragments en clar encastats. Si ni D ni F el desxifren, confirma un tercer cablejat ('C') per al lot A.1232-35 / K.203-208.
